title: Console: internal admin override to reset guided onboarding checklist state
author: Hannah Rivera
body:
Problem: During beta, Support and Console eng need a safe way to reset guided onboarding checklist state for an org/project when troubleshooting validation edge-cases (e.g., "first successful request" signal lag, streaming validator false negatives) or when a user wants to replay onboarding after misconfiguration. Today this requires direct DB edits and is slow/risky.

This PR adds an internal-only admin override that can reset checklist state for a specific org + project, with guardrails (RBAC, audit logging, reason required) and no exposure in the customer-facing UI.

Scope:
- Add internal admin API endpoint to reset checklist state (server-side)
- Add Console internal admin panel action (only visible to internal users) to trigger reset with reason
- Emit audit log entry and internal telemetry event
- Tests + permission checks

Implementation notes:
- Endpoint: POST /api/internal/admin/onboarding/checklist/reset
- Request requires org_id, project_id, and reason (freeform string, capped length)
- Server enforces InternalAdmin role (existing internal RBAC gate) and rejects non-internal sessions
- Reset behavior: sets checklist state to "not_started" and clears per-step completion timestamps + validator-derived signals; does NOT delete request logs or usage analytics
- Idempotency: supports X-Idempotency-Key; repeated calls with same key are no-ops
- Audit: writes an "admin_action" audit log record with actor_user_id, org_id, project_id, reason, and request_id
- Telemetry: emits onboarding_checklist_state_reset (internal-only dataset; property allowlist enforced)

Why internal-only (no customer button): reduces risk of accidental resets masking real issues; we can revisit a customer self-serve reset once step validation is stable and we have clearer UX.

Follow-ups (not in this PR):
- Add Support macro / runbook step referencing this tool
- Consider a "reset just one step" option after beta learnings

Testing:
- Unit tests for RBAC + idempotency
- Integration test to ensure state resets and audit log record is created
- Manual: verified via internal admin panel against a test org; checklist UI reloads and replays from step 1

Release notes: none (internal-only capability)
commits: console/internal-admin: add reset checklist action UI + modal w/ reason
api/internal-admin: add checklist reset endpoint w/ RBAC + input validation
onboarding/state: implement reset operation + idempotency key storage
audit: add admin_action record for checklist resets
tests: coverage for permissions, reset semantics, and idempotency
conversation:
Chloe Martin (review): Can we ensure this is strictly internal-only and cannot be reached by customer sessions even if they guess the route? Also please confirm we’re not logging any prompt/request content.

Hannah Rivera (author): Yep. Route is under /internal/admin/* and gated by requireInternalAdmin which checks session.is_internal == true and role includes InternalAdmin. No prompt/request content is read or written; reset only touches checklist state tables. Audit log includes org_id/project_id/reason/request_id/actor.

Jada Williams (review): Reset semantics: do we clear validator-derived signals (first_success_at, first_stream_at) or just step completion? I’m worried about a reset that still immediately re-completes due to cached signals.

Hannah Rivera (author): Clearing both. resetChecklistState() zeros validator signals + per-step completion timestamps. We intentionally do not wipe request logs/metrics; validators will recompute on subsequent runs (which is what we want to verify when debugging).

Dylan Brooks (review): UI: internal page is fine, but please add a confirmation step and require a reason. Also can we show the org/project identifiers in the confirmation copy to avoid fat-finger mistakes?

Hannah Rivera (author): Added required reason (min 5 chars, max 280) and a second confirm screen with org + project displayed. Also added a ‘type RESET’ confirmation for extra safety.

Dev Patel (review): This will help Support a lot. Can we make sure the response includes a short status we can paste back into the ticket? e.g., "reset ok" + request_id.

Hannah Rivera (author): Response now includes { ok: true, request_id }. Also the audit log entry uses the same request_id for cross-reference.

Marcus Lin (security review): Please ensure we have an allowlist for telemetry properties and that the reason string isn’t shipped to the general product analytics stream. Also consider rate limiting.

Hannah Rivera (author): Telemetry event is sent to internal-only stream with explicit property allowlist (org_id, project_id hashed, actor_user_id, request_id, timestamp). The freeform reason is NOT included in telemetry; it’s only in audit logs with standard access controls. Added a small rate limit (10/min per actor) on the endpoint.

Chloe Martin (follow-up): Add an integration test asserting non-internal users receive 403.

Hannah Rivera (author): Added in checklistReset.test.ts.

Chloe Martin: Approved.
Jada Williams: Approved.
Dylan Brooks: Approved.
Marcus Lin: Approved.
